item.title: Setting up Kea DHCP server in OPNsense: a modern alternative to ISC DHCP
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring Kea DHCP in OPNsense. Covers configuring DHCP servers, managing IP address ranges, setting up static assignments, and verifying network operation for reliable and flexible address allocation.
